sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: What did the thirsty crow drop into the pitcher to drink water?
Choose the correct pronoun for the underlined word: 'Rahul' is reading a book.
According to the poem 'Little Drops of Water', what do little drops of water make?
Choose the describing word (adjective) in the sentence: 'The red balloon flew high in the sky.'
Who brings our letters to our house?
Choose the correct article: I saw ___ elephant at the zoo.
In the story 'The Smart Monkey', where did the monkey say he left his heart?
The children are _____ in the park.
Which of these is a Proper Noun (a special name)?
Fill in the blank with the correct joining word: I like apples ___ bananas.
What do you use the bell on your bicycle for? (Write in 1-2 sentences)
questions.answer: I use the bell on my bicycle to ring and let people know I am coming so they can move out of the way.

questions.question_text: How can we feel if a cup of milk is hot or cold without looking at it?
questions.answer: We can feel if a cup of milk is hot or cold by carefully touching the outside of the cup with our hands.

questions.question_text: Name two places you can see in your town or neighborhood.
questions.answer: In my town, I can see a big hospital and a beautiful green park.

questions.question_text: Where is the book if it is resting on top of a table? (Use a position word)
questions.answer: The book is ON the table.

questions.question_text: Write the plural (many) forms of these naming words: 1. bus, 2. tree, 3. box.

sections.section_name: Section C - Grammar & Matching (Fill in the Blanks)

questions.question_text: Fill in the blanks with the correct '-ing' form of the action words given in brackets: 1. The bird is ___ (fly). 2. The baby is ___ (sleep). 3. The boys are ___ (run). 4. She is ___ (eat) an apple. 5. I am ___ (read) a book.

Rewrite these sentences with correct punctuation (Capital letters, full stops, or question marks): 1. what is your name 2. i live in india 3. where are you going 4. the sun is yellow 5. rita is my friend
questions.answer: 1. What is your name? 2. I live in India. 3. Where are you going? 4. The sun is yellow. 5. Rita is my friend.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are taking a new friend around your town. Write 3-4 sentences about the places you will show them.
questions.answer: Welcome to my town! First, I will show you our big yellow school. Then, we can go to the park to play on the swings and slides. Finally, we will visit the bakery to eat some sweet cakes together.

questions.question_text: Look up at the sky in your imagination. What shapes do the clouds make? Describe what you see in 3-4 sentences.
questions.answer: I look up at the blue sky and see big, fluffy white clouds. One cloud looks like a sleeping dog with floppy ears. Another cloud looks like a tall castle with towers. It is very fun to watch the clouds change shapes as they move.
